gates: Exact legal permission for app commercial display, including reproduction rights and any binding attribution
Museum-grade faithful 2D reproduction, no glare or visual distortion, no artificial enhancements
No frame in deployed rendition; reversible edge crop preserving painted surface
Subject and object identity match; no false museum/author attribution
Crop QA in native and phone aspect ratios; preserve figures and devotional objects
Only selected paintings in conditional rotation; module-specific final assignment from user

rotationPolicy.daily: Deterministic local-calendar-day selection among approved images; not necessarily hourly change
rotationPolicy.timeOfDay: Approved morning/midday/evening variants, using local time and calendar
rotationPolicy.scripture: Canonical appointed Gospel book Matthew/Mark/Luke/John, fallback to other Scripture image; read 1962 proper first
rotationPolicy.season: Angelus/Regina Cæli via canonical Paschal season resolver, not Gregorian date guess
rotationPolicy.rosary: Traditional fifteen mysteries mapped to selected mystery, with separate per-mystery scene art
rotationPolicy.privacy: Do not infer location; use supplied locale/calendar settings
rotationPolicy.repeat: No duplicate photographs of one painting as independent rotation slots

scopeCaveats: Old 22 image gallery mixes Prayer with Mass Explorer, Scripture, Saints and Historia Salutis: these are not necessarily Prayer-family launchers.
One current route may need >1 visual subpool (Morning/Evening, Angelus/Regina, Adoration/Visit).
Raw 101 count is subject assignments; physical paintings may repeat.
Devotion source ratings 3–5 are research-eligible, not user approvals.
Frame-bearing source may be retained if cropping is reversible; standalone authentic image otherwise required.
